entities.name: PMID:37993041
observations: In 715 healthy 46-year-olds, high versus low accelerometer-measured MVPA was associated with higher LV mass index and left-atrial end-systolic volume index; cardiac function did not differ. Abstract did not report activity cutoffs or absolute structural differences.

entities.name: PMID:34261776
observations: In a mixed-health cohort aged 45–74, each additional 10 min/day MVPA was associated with +0.18 mL/m² LA volume index, better LV mass-to-volume ratio, and better circumferential strain; cross-sectional and not restricted to healthy adults.

entities.name: PMID:29589406
observations: Cross-sectional series of 2,530 healthy volunteers and athletes reported graded relative LV muscular mass from non-athletes to leisure and lower-class athletes; does not isolate moderate intensity or establish causality.

entities.name: Moderate activity remodeling
observations: Evidence suggests activity may associate with modest physiological cardiac structural differences, especially LV mass and atrial volume, but direct causal evidence for substantial remodeling from moderate activity alone is limited.
